articles.summary: Expert insight on building equity, creating long-term wealth, and making the most of homeownership St. Louis, MO (August 10, 2026) With rising housing costs and evolving market conditions often creating confusion and uncertainty, First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) believes homeownership continues to be one of the strongest ways to build long-term wealth and financial stability. While people often choose to rent a home due to lower upfront costs and perceived affordability, Erica Pallardy, Mortgage Loan Officer at First Mid, shares that many renters could instead own a home and make mortgage payments that are equivalent to or even lower than their monthly rent payments. Over time, those payments contribute toward building equity, an asset that can provide financial flexibility and support future goals. Although buying a home may look different today than it did 20 years ago, homeownership is still one of the best investments people can make, said Pallardy.
articles.title: First Mid Bank & Trust Explains Why Buying a Home is Smarter Than Renting

articles.summary: Mattoon, IL (August 17, 2026) First Mid Insurance Group (FMIG), a leading provider of insurance solutions, is proud to announce it has once again been recognized as a Best Practices Agency for 2026, marking the seventh time it has achieved this honor. This recognition places FMIG among an exclusive group of independent insurance agencies nationwide. The Best Practices Agency designation is awarded to participants in the Best Practices Study, a comprehensive analysis of the business operations and performance of the insurance industry's top-performing independent agencies. More than 1,190 independent insurance agencies across the United States were nominated during this study cycle. For the 2026 study year, only 300 agencies qualified for and maintained their Best Practices Agency designation. articles.summary: Mattoon, IL (August 24, 2026) First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) is proud to announce that Bryan Mitchell, VP, Director of Enterprise IT Support, successfully completed the Graduate School of Banking program at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, marking a significant achievement in his professional career. He also earned the Certificate of Executive Leadership from the Wisconsin School of Business Professional and Executive Development, its highest-level leadership certificate. Mitchell has been a valued member of the First Mid team for almost five years. With an extensive background in information technology, he brings strong technical expertise and leadership experience to the organization. In 2023, Mitchell received the First Mid Chairmans Award for Excellence, the companys highest employee recognition, honoring team members who demonstrate First Mids core values while making exceptional contributions to the organization.
